app.name: SaaS Platform
app.description: A modern SaaS application with subscription management, team collaboration, and analytics

requirements.description: Full-featured SaaS platform with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing, team management, and comprehensive dashboard
features: User authentication with magic link, password, and OAuth (Google, GitHub)
Team management with roles (owner, admin, member)

screens.name: Marketing Landing
screens.description: Beautiful landing page with hero, features grid, pricing table, testimonials, FAQ, and CTA sections

screens.name: Pricing
screens.description: Detailed pricing page with feature comparison table and FAQ

screens.name: Login
screens.description: Clean login page with email/password, magic link, and OAuth buttons

screens.name: Sign Up
screens.description: Registration with workspace creation and plan selection

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.description: Main dashboard with KPI cards, charts, activity feed, and quick actions

screens.name: Analytics
screens.description: Detailed analytics with date range picker, multiple chart types, and export

screens.name: Team
screens.description: Team member management with invite, role assignment, and removal

screens.name: Billing
screens.description: Subscription management, usage display, invoice history, and payment methods

screens.name: Settings
screens.description: Workspace settings, profile, notifications, API keys, and webhooks

screens.name: API Docs
screens.description: Interactive API documentation with code examples
